releases.title: Professional Due Diligence and navigation polish
releases.summary: Added a lazy-loaded closing and collateral preflight backed by live NJ DCA permit/certificate records and NJDEP contaminated-site, deed-notice, groundwater CEA, underground-storage-tank, Tidelands, Highlands and Pinelands layers. Redesigned the shared desktop sidebar into animated drill-down groups with a separate five-item mobile navigation, removed Dashboard metric dividers, rounded and polished Home Agent Intel, and made Historical Property Time Machine collapsed by default.

releases.title: Exempt/PILOT, Added/Omitted and Farmland tools
releases.summary: Completed roadmap items 3, 4 and 5 as separate lazy-loaded tools. Added statewide exempt-property/PILOT exposure from the 2025 Abstract and DCA's 2026 PILOT database, a saved-property added/omitted assessment monitor with current AA-1 deadline guidance, and a 2026 Farmland Assessment qualification/rollback screener. Also repaired Dashboard property cards so Assessed, Tax, Market Value and both intelligence strips remain visible on desktop and mobile.

releases.title: Municipal Budget Pressure
releases.summary: Built a statewide municipal fiscal-pressure model from five years of NJ DCA tax tables plus the User-Friendly Budget Database. Added explainable pressure bands, levy and organic-ratable trends, municipal/school/county components, budget growth, debt, collections and structural-imbalance context across Dashboard, Home, Agent Intel, town reports, town comparison and exports.

releases.title: Shared home-ownership verification flow
releases.summary: Changed Claim as my home so it immediately offers postcard verification after saving, added an explicit Not now path that leaves the home unverified, repaired Verify ownership on Home, and moved Lookup, Dashboard and Home onto one shared verification module.

releases.title: EmailJS administrator delivery for manual postcards
releases.summary: Connected the secure verification worker to the existing EmailJS account and template. Codes and mailing instructions go only to the administrator, while the EmailJS private key remains protected in Supabase secrets.

releases.title: Mobile property-card repair and manual postcard fulfillment
releases.summary: Corrected Town Intelligence so property cards no longer receive an undefined status class, allowed mobile cards to grow with their data, and replaced PostGrid with a secure administrator-email workflow for manually mailed verification postcards.

releases.title: Verification delivery, Property Time Machine and state-data automation
releases.summary: Added secure postal ownership-code delivery infrastructure and diagnostics, upgraded assessment drift into a detailed Historical Property Time Machine, added a review-first automated state-data refresh pipeline, and repaired expansion of the shared sidebar on every page.

releases.title: Visual version tracker and project roadmap
releases.summary: Added a permanent visual change history, impact charts and prioritized project roadmap. Future releases will receive exact timestamps in this data file.

roadmap.title: Exhaust New Jersey professional data sources
roadmap.why: Professional workflows should be built on the widest defensible state-data foundation before lower-priority roadmap work resumes. The first live due-diligence layer now covers DCA permits plus eight NJDEP closing and land-use signals.
deliverables: field catalog for every Pro and Pro+ datapoint

roadmap.title: Pro+ Data Center
roadmap.why: Every validated data point should land in one customizable property, town or county sheet after the professional field inventory is broad enough to justify the interface.

roadmap.title: Modularize lookup.js
roadmap.why: Lookup remains the last major JavaScript monolith, but feature work is intentionally paused while the Pro/Pro+ data foundation is expanded.

roadmap.title: Appeal outcome logging and predictive foundation
roadmap.why: A defensible predictive model requires real parcel-level outcomes; collection can resume after the professional public-data inventory is exhausted.

roadmap.title: Static town report landing pages
roadmap.why: Growth pages are intentionally behind data depth and professional utility for now.
